description: Passive first-order RC low-pass filter: the signal goes from J_IN through R1 (1 kΩ) to J_OUT, and C1 (100 nF) connects the output to ground (fc ≈ 1.59 kHz).
assumptions: Passive filter: no supply connector is needed, and J_IN and J_OUT share a common ground.
J_IN (positive = signal, negative = ground) and J_OUT (positive = filtered output, negative = ground) are hand-wired connection points.
Cutoff frequency fc = 1/(2π·1 kΩ·100 nF) ≈ 1.59 kHz, assuming the output load is high-impedance (well above 1 kΩ).
The default _gap_0 resistor variant is used; the ceramic capacitor is unpolarised, so its orientation does not matter.
